titulo_es: Imperfect in front of prossimo passage

al mare.es: a la playa; en el mar
al mare.en: to the beach; in the sea

bloques.titulo: The scenario in front of the event
texto: The **imperfetto** paints the background: atmospheric time, time, age, mood or developing actions (* Pioveva forte *, * Faceva molto brodo *, * Ero stanco *).
The **passato prossimo** introduces the facts that happen in this scenario: the concrete actions completed (* Ieri sono andato al mare *, * A a certo point è arrivato Luca *).

filas: Ieri ha fatto freddo tutto il giorno.
Domenica scorsa sono andato al mare.

frases.it: Ieri ho sentito Sara al telefono.
frases.es: Ayer hablé con Sara por teléfono.
frases.en: I spoke to Sara on the phone yesterday.
analisis: I spoke to Sara (I heard her)

frases.it: Era contenta, ma a Torino pioveva molto.
frases.es: Estaba contenta, pero en Turín llovía mucho.
frases.en: I was happy, but in Turin it was raining a lot.

frases.it: E che cosa ha fatto ieri?
frases.en: And what did you do yesterday?

frases.it: È rimasta a casa e ha letto un libro.
frases.es: Se quedó en casa y leyó un libro.
frases.en: He stayed home and read a book.

frases.it: Da piccolo andavo al mare tutti i giorni.
frases.es: De pequeño iba a la playa todos los días.
frases.en: When I was a kid, I went to the beach every day.
analisis: I was going to the beach.

frases.it: C'era il sole, faceva molto caldo e stavo bene.
frases.es: Hacía sol, hacía mucho calor y estaba bien.
frases.en: It was sunny, it was so hot and it was fine.

frases.it: Giocavo al mare con i miei amici.
frases.es: Jugaba en la playa con mis amigos.
frases.en: I was playing on the beach with my friends.

bloques.pregunta: What verbal time is used to express a regular action that was repeated in the past?

opciones.explicacion: The imperfect is the narrative time par excellence to describe past customs and routines.
It is used for time-specific and delimited facts.
It expresses future actions, not customs of the past.

bloques.pregunta: What is the correct sentence to express «I went to the beach yesterday.» as a concrete fact?

opciones.explicacion: Done closed at a time of time in the past: prossimo passato.
«Andavo» would express a repeated custom, not a punctual journey from yesterday.

bloques.frase: Ieri a Roma ___ molto caldo per tutto il giorno.

opciones.explicacion: When referring to a specific day with a time limit, «ha fatto» is used.
It would provide a background description without a precise limit.
He is the first person («I did.»).

bloques.frase: Quando ero piccolo, mangiavo volentieri la frutta.

opciones.texto: When I was little, I ate fruit with pleasure.
opciones.explicacion: «Ero» and «mangiavo» describe a continuous stage and habit.

opciones.texto: When I was little, I ate fruit one day.
opciones.explicacion: Distorts the value of the repeated habit that marks the imperfect.

opciones.texto: When I'm little, I'll eat fresh fruit.
opciones.explicacion: Prayer refers to the past, not the future.

bloques.pregunta: What is the temporal relationship between the two actions?
bloques.frase: Leggevo un libro quando è arrivato Luca.

opciones.texto: Reading was the ongoing action and Luca's arrival was the punctual fact that happened.
opciones.explicacion: «Leggevo» (imperfet) describes the background action; «è arrivato» (prossimo passato) the spot event.

opciones.texto: Luca came first and then I started reading.
opciones.explicacion: The text indicates that I was already reading when Luca arrived.

opciones.texto: Ambas acciones terminaron simultáneamente antes de ayer.
opciones.explicacion: One action interrupts or coincides with the development of the other.

bloques.frase: Ieri pioveva e faceva molto freddo
bloques.traduccion: Yesterday it rained and it was very cold

bloques.pregunta: How do you say in Italian «When I was a kid, I lived in the field.»?

opciones.texto: Quando ero bambino abitavo in campagna.
opciones.explicacion: Both sentences describe a continuous stage in imperfect.

opciones.texto: Quando sono stato bambino ho abitato in campagna.
opciones.explicacion: The prossimo passage would fragment a descriptive life stage.

opciones.texto: Quando ero bambino abito in campagna.
opciones.explicacion: Blend incorrectly past with the indicative present.

intro: Now you will learn to combine the prossimo passage and the imfect to narrate events by placing them in their context.
